name: Two 0-1 Sequences
justification: One clean observation collapses both operations; two-line check, YES/NO verdicts.
solution_sketch: Only the first n-m+1 elements of a can be merged, and they can become 0 or 1 iff that value appears among them. So answer is YES iff a's last m-1 chars equal b's last m-1 chars and b[0] occurs in a[0..n-m].
